caption: The drawing depicts a single, full-length cape with a circular shape and a scalloped hem, positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The cape is light blue with shading that suggests folds in the fabric, and it is decorated with pale blue embroidery along the edges and down the front opening. The embroidery design includes floral and foliate patterns. There is a round collar at the neckline, also edged with embroidery, and the cape is fastened at the neck with braided blue cords that end in tassels. On either side of the cape, there are two faintly drawn, rectangular diagrams featuring outline sketches of floral and branch motifs, one to the left and one to the right. In the bottom right corner, there is a small section of handwritten text.
title: Child's Cape
